Pray, permit me to endeavour to convey the sentiment in a manner befitting the refined sensibilities of our era. I propose to endeavour to ignite a spark, a tiny, tantalizing ember that would, perchance, ignite a conflagration of passion within thy bosom.

In sooth, I am not enamoured with the notion of precipitating a catastrophe, a calamity of unmitigated proportions. Nay, my dear, I merely wish to initiate a gentle, insidious process, one that would, with time, kindle a flame of ardour within thy heart.

Pray, permit me to endeavour to convey the sentiment in a manner befitting the rarefied atmosphere of our esteemed society. I propose to endeavour to kindle a spark, a tiny, tantalizing flame that would, perchance, ignite a conflagration of passion within thy breast.
